# Wormleighton Gravel Pits - lorry loads out, August 2026

One row per load; tonnes is the weight at the weighbridge. The office exported the first half of the month twice while chasing a fault in the weighbridge software, so a few loads are written out more than once.

turns.prompt: Wormleighton Gravel Pits settles its haulage accounts at the end of the month. How many loads did Coldborough Transport take out in August 2026? Give the count as a number alone. Reply with only the final answer. If you cannot determine the answer, reply exactly UNKNOWN.
